toc.title: Assertio Lamberti Danaei quod humana Christi natura neque in unione personali &c.

book: A single polemical treatise by Lambertus Danaeus (Geneva, 1585): a title page, then the Assertio, which runs with two running-head divisions, Sectio I and a section against Jacobus Schmidelin's writing on the adoration of Christ's flesh.
